data.evidence_sentence: Awarded to students who meet all eligibility criteria for need-based financial aid.
data.notes: Name refers to a need-based scholarship page covering several awards (BU Promise, BU Community Leader, Charles River Housing, University Scholarship, International Student Need-Based Scholarships) with different criteria; the name does not match one specific award. Award amounts are based on demonstrated need, so funding_type partial is inferred from 'up to full financial need'. Deadline date not stated on page; financial aid deadline is referenced but not given. Degree level bachelor inferred from undergraduate references (BU Promise: maximum eight undergraduate semesters; Community Leader: first-year and transfer students). Renewal GPA of 2.00 and 75% course completion apply only to keep the award and are not entry requirements. Priority/selection by availability of funds for program of study is not a requirement. International Student need-based scholarships are limited to select partnership programs; nationality not explicitly restricted for other awards.
